description: The figure shows two separate vertical bar charts illustrating Fleiss’ Kappa agreement values under different experimental conditions, with numeric values annotated above each bar. In the left chart, the horizontal axis contains four category labels (shown as approximately 0.88, 0.46, 0.82, and 0.94 in that left-to-right order), and the vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” on a linear scale with visible tick marks around 0.2 increments (e.g., 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8) spanning roughly 0 to just under 1.0; the four bars are shaded in blue tones and have annotated heights of about 0.88 (darkest blue, tallest), 0.46 (medium blue), 0.03 (very short, light blue), and 0.24 (light blue). In the right chart, the horizontal axis is labeled “Max Ambiguity” with categories 1, 2, and 3 arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is again labeled “Fleiss Kappa” on a linear scale starting at 0.0 with ticks at about 0.2 intervals up to around 0.8–1.0; three blue bars are shown with annotated values of approximately 0.88 for Max Ambiguity 1 (dark blue), 0.46 for Max Ambiguity 2 (medium blue), and 0.23 for Max Ambiguity 3 (lighter blue). No legend is visible, the bars are not stacked or grouped beyond their single-series arrangement, and there is no explicit indication that categories are sorted beyond the displayed left-to-right order; the primary emphasis comes from the value labels placed above each bar.
